reference: Mose gblɔ na wo be, “Esiawoe nye abolo si Yehowa na mi be miaɖu.
hypothesis: Múse gblɔ na wo ɖe, asi awɔenya gbɔlo si Yehowa na mǐ ba mǐa?

reference: Woalũ ɖe dziwò, adze dziwò abe ale si hɔ̃ lũna ɖe nu dzi ƒona ene.
hypothesis: míawo na dzo, adze dzo, abe alesi ho nu na dzo, nu dzi fona

reference: Aƒetɔ ate wò ɖe anyi, awɔ funyafunya wò va se ɖe esime nàtsrɔ̃ vɔ.
hypothesis: Kpaatɔ atɔ̃aɖeewonyi, woafunyafunyawɔ va se ɖe ma, na ɖeɔ vɔ.

reference: Kpɔ ɖa, eƒe ŋkekewo katã nye vevesese ko eye eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo katã nye nuxaxa ko.
hypothesis: Woa, afɔ ka koo ka tɔa nye vɔsɛsɛ koe, aee, afɔ do koo ka tɔa nye nuxaxakoe.

reference: Nye ŋutɔe lɔ̃ xe ga home ma ke na ame sia ame.
hypothesis: Nyawo siawo le ŋɔŋlɔm le agbalẽa me

reference: Ekpa kerubi eve ƒe nɔnɔme ɖe kɔkɔeƒewo ƒe kɔkɔeƒe la, eye wofa sika ɖe wo ŋu.
hypothesis: E kpe pakelu bi eve fe nɔnɔme, dɔkɔkwo fe wo, kpekpewo fe la, eye wo va sikade wo nunu.

reference: Ne meho wo ɖa vɔ megbe la, magakpɔ nublanui na wo.
hypothesis: Mewɔ ɖo aƒeme gbɔla, ma gakpɔ nu blaye na o.
